theme.why: Lacquer-black translucent panels with bone-white text and gold trim follow the ukiyo-e art direction; ink is light because the panels are dark. Water's UI colour is lightened from the 3D indigo so it reads on black.

phase_glyphs.how: drawn as text (the Five Phases' own characters) inside a brush circle in the phase colour; no image needed

icons.style: flat ukiyo-e woodblock game icon, bold black outline, simple shape

icons.route: Planned: gen_icons_cf.py on Cloudflare Workers AI (CF_ACCOUNT_ID and CF_API_TOKEN, unset today), then icon_cutout.py and glyphs.py. Upload as Image, never Decal.

rules: Mobile first: every interactive control at least 88 px tall at the 1280x720 reference (44 pt on a phone).
Keep the thumbstick zone (bottom left), the jump zone (bottom right) and the 36 px top bar clear; the ability bar is bottom-centre.
The common action is one key or one tap; picking a fighter is two clicks (card, then Cross).
Never hardcode a text colour: ink, inkSoft, onDark from the theme.
Placeholders are strings the live code can never produce; samples are the longest strings it will write.
